changes.basis: Native stock excitation reported physics scenes stepping at different rates; a reusable prop must inherit its host simulation scene.

Freely rotating handle bearing was encoded using a +/-2000-revolution placeholder. Stock SDK derives a 300000 degree/s drive from that finite placeholder. Author continuous revolute travel; the unchanged SDK applies its documented temporary +/-30 degree excitation bound for unlimited joints.

articulation.note: Joint existence, enabled state, references and ordered limits checked; joint actuation is not revalidated by this metadata audit.
